picks.what: The city from Pierścienica hill, photograph
picks.why: best of a weak modern set: the city spread along the horizon beyond the forest; trimmed the ski slope in front

gaps: P0–P3: no candidates. P5: only a 1918 reprint of the same Sanecki photograph (#4). P6 has no view of the historic center.
notes: #3: the card was printed after 1906 (catalog ‘post 1906’) and the same photograph reappears on a card dated 1918 (#4), hence ‘about 1910’. #1 (a house in a garden) and #2 (a distant field with barracks, about 1885) are too weak to use. P6: #8 shows housing estates, not landmarks; drop it if a center view is required. #7 is similar (scrub in front); #5/#6 are a 17,500 × 600 px strip panorama, unusable at card size.
